product.name: Science and Sustainability Communication Consultancy
product.description: Provides consultancy services to help clients communicate scientific and sustainability topics effectively to drive social, economic, and environmental impact.

product.name: Science Communication Events and Forums
product.description: Organizes and manages events and forums that bring together science journalists, communicators, and stakeholders to share knowledge and promote science communication.

identifier.value: Science Communication Training and Curriculum Development

product.name: Science Communication Training and Curriculum Development
product.description: Develops and promotes science communication educational programs and training, especially focusing on Arabic language and regional context.

identifier.value: Research Media Impact Analysis and Strategic Communication Planning

product.name: Research Media Impact Analysis and Strategic Communication Planning
product.description: Analyzes media coverage and impact of scientific research and advises institutions on enhancing their research communication strategies.

product.name: Science Journalism Freelance Platform (JourLance)
product.description: A platform connecting freelance science journalists with publishers to facilitate the creation of diverse science communication projects globally.

product.name: Scientific Arab Magazine
product.description: A subscription-based magazine that communicates science and technology topics to the Arab public, focusing on younger audiences like Gen Z.
